input.command:
cat > .suspense/history/1790500332-Prompt_d1ad8c15d5717e4e.understanding.md <<'EOF'
- [Typing in the editor clears any hover overlay from the language server straight away](spec/scope/editor/index.pi)
- [A cleared hover overlay comes back only once the pointer moves over a name again](spec/scope/editor/index.pi)
- [Hovering a name shows the server's textDocument/hover](spec/scope/editor/index.pi)
- [Diagnostics are underlined, their message shown on hover](spec/scope/editor/index.pi)
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='spec/scope/editor/index.pi'
s=open(p).read()
old='''        hover:
            Hovering a name shows the server's `textDocument/hover`.
'''
new='''        hover:
            Hovering a name shows the server's `textDocument/hover`. Typing in
            the editor clears whatever the pointer's hover shows, the name's
            hover and a diagnostic's message alike, as soon as a key changes
            the text, and nothing hovered shows again until the pointer next
            moves over the text.
'''
assert old in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
p='src/file_view.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''        let text = self.editor.read(cx).value();
        self.dirty = text.as_ref() != saved;
'''
new='''        let text = self.editor.read(cx).value();
        self.dirty = text.as_ref() != saved;
        // What the pointer's hover showed goes as soon as the text changes.
        self.editor.update(cx, |editor, cx| {
            editor.clear_hover_state(cx);
            editor.clear_diagnostic_popover(cx);
        });
'''
assert old in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF

content.text:
In the editor, any keystroke that changes the text now closes the hover popup straight away. That covers both the language server's hover for a name and a diagnostic's message. A popup only comes back once the mouse moves over the text again. The spec builds, and 272 of 273 tests pass; the one failure is the same `...`/`…` default-prompt test as before.

- **Spec:** the hover rule under the editor's language support in `spec/scope/editor/index.pi` now says typing clears whatever the hover shows.
- **Code:** `src/file_view.rs` clears both kinds of popup whenever the text changes.
- **Test:** the new `typing_clears_hovers` test shows a hover, types a character, and checks the hover is gone. It fails without the fix.
